I work as a postdoctoral researcher at the
[Institute of Electrical Power Systems and High Voltage Engineering](https://tu-dresden.de/ing/elektrotechnik/ieeh),
TUD Dresden University of Technology, in the Power Quality research group of
[Prof. Jan Meyer](https://tu-dresden.de/ing/elektrotechnik/ieeh/ev/die-professur/mitarbeiter/jan-meyer).

My research interests include Data Mining and Power Quality.

## Interests

- Electrical Power Systems
- Power Quality
- Data Science & Data Mining
- R
